name: 金数据
description: Build forms and manage form data on Jinshuju with natural language.
description_zh: 创建、管理和分析金数据表单与表格，用自然语言创建、复制、编辑表单与主题，批量增删改查表单与表格数据，查询账户套餐与团队成员。
description_en: Create, manage, and analyze data forms and tables. Use natural language to create, copy, and edit forms and topics. Perform batch addition, deletion, modification, and query of form and table data. Query account packages and team members.
examples_zh: 帮我做一个训练营报名表，299 元一位，限 60 人报名
帮我分析这个月的满意度调研数据，看看用户最关心的问题是什么
查一下上周报名表里还没缴费的人，列个清单
examples_en: Please help me create a training camp registration form. It costs 299 yuan per person, and there's a limit of 60 people who can register.
Please help me analyze this month's satisfaction survey data to see what users care about most.
Check the registration forms from last week for those who haven't paid yet, and make a list.
